blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: To defend against backdoor attacks on neural networks, the defender must identify the verifier function that determines whether an input is a trigger, rather than rejecting individual triggers in isolation, since an attacker can generate new triggers satisfying the same verifier faster than they can be blocked. If a backdoor verifier could be installed with the asymmetry of a cryptographic authentication scheme, in which only the attacker can produce trigger inputs while the defender cannot reverse-engineer the verifier from observations, learning-based defense would be impossible in principle. We show that no such asymmetry can arise from poisoning-based installation, in which the only verifier-dependent input to training is a poisoned dataset. The argument is a reduction. A training procedure that installs a verifier from poisoned data, so that the backdoor fires on unseen triggers while benign behavior is preserved, is itself a learner for that verifier. Any verifier that is computationally hard to learn is therefore impossible to install through poisoning, and any verifier that poisoning can install is reconstructible by a white-box defender holding comparably many labeled trigger observations. A complementary argument shows that a secret key supplied to the model at inference is observable to the same defender. The result takes representative trigger observations as given and concerns when the backdoor fires rather than what it does. Experiments on instruction-tuned large language models confirm the dichotomy, with no configuration yielding a backdoor that is both effective for the attacker and irrecoverable for the defender.
blocks.zh: 为了抵御对神经网络的后门攻击,维权者必须识别确定一个输入是否是触发器的验证器功能,而不是孤立地拒绝单个触发器,因为攻击者可以生成满足同一验证器的新触发器比被阻断的速度快. 如果一个后门验证器可以安装一个密码认证方案的不对称,其中只有攻击者可以产生触发输入,而捍卫者不能将验证器反向工程从观测中安装,那么基于学习的防御原则上是不可能的. 我们显示,基于中毒的安装不会产生这种不对称,在这种安装中,对培训的唯一依赖核查者的投入是有毒的数据集。 辩才为减. 一种从有毒数据中安装一个验证器的训练程序,这样在保持良性行为的同时,暗中引发后门火灾,它本身就是该验证器的学习者. 因此,任何在计算上难以学习的验证器都不可能通过中毒方式安装,任何可以安装中毒的验证器都可以由白盒维权者重建,持有相当多标签的触发观察. 一个补充论点表明,同一辩护人可以观察到为模型提供的推断秘密钥匙。 其结果是在后门起火时而不是在后门起火时提出具有代表性的触发意见并引起关切。 对指令调制的大语言模型的实验证实了二分法,没有配置产生既对攻击者有效的后门,又对捍卫者不可恢复的后门.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Backdoor attacks plant a hidden trigger condition in a model during training, which we refer to as the verifier : inputs satisfying the condition elicit attacker-specified malicious behavior, while all other inputs are processed normally ( Wallace et al., 2021 ; Kurita et al., 2020 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Carlini et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Ge et al., 2025 ) .
Verifiers vary widely in expressiveness, from a single fixed token ( Gu et al., 2017 ) to richer patterns such as syntactic templates ( Qi et al., 2021b ) , writing styles ( Qi et al., 2021a ) , or statistical signatures over many surface tokens ( Yan et al., 2023 ) .
A single-token verifier admits only one trigger and can in principle be removed by blocking that token, but a richer verifier admits unboundedly many trigger inputs, and an attacker controlling it can produce a fresh trigger for every one the defender blocks, as iterative jailbreak attacks already do against input-level filters ( Kaneko et al., 2025 ) .
Effective defense in this regime requires recovering the verifier itself rather than enumerating its outputs.
blocks.zh:
后门攻击在训练期间在模型中植入一个隐藏的触发条件,我们称之为验证器:满足条件的输入会引发攻击者指定的恶意行为,而所有其他输入则得到正常处理(Wallace等人,2021年;Kurita等人,2020年;Kandpal等人,2023年;赵等人,2024年;Carlini等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年;Ge等人,2025年)。
验证符在表达方式上差异很大,从单一固定符(Gu et al.,2017年)到较丰富的图案,如合成模板(Qi et al.,2021b),写作风格(Qi et al.,2021a),或者统计签名超过许多表面符(Yan et al.,2023年).
一个单键验证器只承认一个触发器,原则上可以通过屏蔽该指示符来移除,但更丰富的验证器则承认无限制的很多触发输入,而控制它的攻击者可以对每一个捍卫者块产生新的触发器,就像迭代的越狱攻击已经对输入级过滤器做了一样(Kaneko等人,2025年).
这一制度的有效防御要求恢复核查者本身,而不是列举其产出。

blocks.en:
The attacker, by virtue of constructing the verifier, generates trigger inputs trivially, while the defender, observing only the model’s behavior, must recover the verifier from a finite sample of triggered and benign inputs.
This is the asymmetry that defines cryptographic authentication. A secret-holder produces valid instances trivially, while no other party can reverse-engineer the underlying function from observations alone, as exemplified by digital signatures and keyed pseudorandom functions ( Goldreich et al., 1986 ; Goldwasser et al., 1988 ) .
The natural concern, then, is whether a backdoor verifier could be installed with this kind of cryptographic hardness. If so, no learning-based reconstruction would suffice in principle, and verifier-level defense would face an impossibility result borrowed directly from cryptography.
blocks.zh:
攻击者通过构筑验证器产生微小的触发输入,而捍卫者只观察模型的行为,必须从有限的触发和良性输入样本中恢复验证器。
这是定义密码认证的不对称. 秘密持有者产生有效实例是微不足道的,而其他任何当事方都无法仅从观测中逆向生成基本功能,数字签名和按键伪随机功能就是例证(Goldreich等人,1986年;Goldwasser等人,1988年)。
因此,自然的担心是,能否安装这种加密硬度的后门核查器。 如果是这样,原则上说,任何基于学习的重建都是不够的,而核查员一级的防御将面临直接从密码学中借用的不可能的结果。

blocks.en:
A substantial body of work on trigger inversion has addressed verifier recovery in practice, employing gradient-based search, generative inversion, or activation-space analysis ( Azizi et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Shen et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2024b ) .
Despite empirical progress, the foundational question of whether such reconstruction is principally possible, and under what conditions it might fail, remains unresolved.
In particular, it is not known whether an attacker can install a verifier that is functionally cryptographic: easy for the attacker to evaluate by construction, yet provably unreconstructible by any defender even with white-box access. 1 1 1 We adopt the standard threat model in which the defender has white-box access to the model. This reflects the typical deployment setting, where backdoor defense is performed by the model owner or a downstream auditor inspecting weights, activations, and gradients before deployment ( Liu et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2022 ) . If such verifiers exist, trigger inversion is a fundamentally limited approach.
blocks.zh:
关于触发反转的大量工作涉及在实践中核查器的恢复,采用基于梯度的搜索、基因反转或激活空间分析(Azizi等人,2021年;Liu等人,2022年;沈等人,2022年;徐等人,2024年b).
尽管取得了经验性进展,但这种重建是否主要有可能,以及在什么条件下可能失败这一根本问题仍未解决。
特别是,还不清楚攻击者是否可以安装一个功能性加密的核查器:攻击者很容易通过构造来评估,但任何捍卫者即使有白箱访问权也无法证明无法重建. 页:1 1,我们采用标准威胁模型,其中维权者可使用白盒进入模型. 这反映了典型的部署设置,即由模型所有者或下游审计师在部署前进行后门防御检查重量,激活,梯度(刘等人,2018年;王等人,2019年;李等人,2022年). 如果存在这种核查者,触发倒置是一种根本有限的办法。

blocks.en:
We answer this question in the negative for poisoning-based backdoors, those in which the attacker’s only verifier-dependent input to training is a poisoned dataset, and we locate where cryptographic asymmetry can still enter.
The information determining the verifier must reach the model through some channel, learned from poisoned data, planted through the randomness of training, written directly into the weights, supplied as a secret at inference, or delegated to an external oracle, and our theory addresses the first and the fourth. A learning-theoretic formalization of cryptographic asymmetry for backdoors (Definition 5 ) translates the cryptographic notion into a form amenable to PAC analysis and restricts the installer to the poisoning channel. A reduction from installation to learning (Lemma 1 , Corollary 1 ) shows that a poisoning procedure which installs a verifier, so that the backdoor fires on unseen triggers and benign behavior is preserved, is itself a polynomial-time learner for that verifier.
Efficiently learnable verifiers are therefore reconstructible by the defender with comparable sample complexity (Theorem 1 ), computationally unlearnable verifiers cannot be installed through poisoning at all, and within the poisoning channel installable and efficiently learnable coincide. A structural impossibility for key embedding (Proposition 1 ) shows that any cryptographic secret usable by the model at inference is observable to a white-box defender.
The remaining channels are where cryptographic backdoors live. Goldwasser et al. (2022) and Draguns et al. (2024) plant the verifier through the training randomness and through direct weight specification, respectively, outside the reduction.
The result takes representative labeled observations of the trigger condition as given, and it concerns the verifier, that is, when the backdoor fires rather than what it does.

我们用基于中毒的后门的负数来回答这个问题,那些攻击者对训练的唯一核查者依赖的输入是有毒的数据集,我们找到密码不对称仍然可以输入的地方。
确定核查者的信息必须通过某种渠道到达模型,从有毒数据中吸取教训,通过随机的训练植入,直接写入权重,作为推论的秘密提供,或者委托给外部的甲骨文,我们的理论涉及第一和第四. 后门密码不对称的学习-理论形式化(定义5 )将密码概念转化为一种适合PAC分析的形式,并将安装器限制在中毒通道. 从安装到学习的减少(Lemma 1, Corollary 1 )表明,安装验证器的中毒程序,使得隐形触发器和良性行为的后门火灾得以保存,它本身就是该验证器的多诺时学习者.

其余的渠道是密码学后门居住的地方. Goldwasser等人(2022年)和Draguns等人(2024年)通过训练随机性和直接重量规格分别将核查器植入还原外。
其结果是对触发条件按规定进行具有代表性的标记观察,它涉及核查者,即后门起火时,而不是它做什么。

blocks.en:
Experiments on instruction-tuned LLMs confirm the dichotomy across four 7–9B models, with a 70B-scale replication in Appendix A .
A learnable verifier and an LWR-based cryptographic verifier are installed and reconstructed under identical budgets, and attack success and defender reconstruction rise together for the first and sit at chance together for the second.
On a verifier family of varying complexity, the defender’s sample count tracks the attacker’s within a constant factor, with ground-truth labels and with noisy labels from an existing trigger inversion method.
Across three ways of supplying a secret key to the model, the key is either inert for the attacker or observable to the defender.
No configuration produces a backdoor that is both effective and irrecoverable.
blocks.zh:
指导调制LLMs的实验确认了四个7-9B模型的二聚体,附录A中有一个70B级的复制。
在同样的预算下,安装并重建了一个可学习的核查员和一个基于LWR的加密核查员,攻击成功,捍卫者重建一起起来进行第一次,并一起把握机会进行第二次。
在复杂程度各异的核查人家族中,辩护人的样本计数以恒定因子追踪攻击者,用地面真实的标签,用现有的触发反转方法进行噪音的标签。
在提供模型的秘密钥匙的三种方式中,钥匙要么是攻击者的惰性,要么是维护者所看到的。
任何配置都不会产生既有效又无法恢复的后门.

A procedure that installs V V from poisoned data must output a model that fires on unseen triggers and stays benign elsewhere, so reading off whether the model fires gives a classifier that agrees with V V on fresh inputs, and the installer is a learner for V V . The defender faces the same learning problem, which yields the dichotomy of Corollary 1 . A separate argument (Proposition 1 ) handles a secret consulted at inference rather than learned.

blocks.en: Labeled observation is part of the security game in Definition 5 (ii), not a convenience introduced in the proof. The game separates two questions, whether a defender can obtain representative observations of the trigger condition, and whether reconstruction from such observations is computationally harder than installation. Our results answer the second. White-box access does not by itself yield representative trigger examples, and an attacker who makes the trigger distribution sparse or obfuscated makes the first question hard. In practice trigger samples come from red teaming or post-incident analysis ( Tran et al., 2018 ; Chen et al., 2018 ; Perez et al., 2022 ; Hubinger et al., 2024 ) , with non-trigger samples drawn from ordinary interaction logs, and the information such queries can extract per call is itself bounded ( Kaneko and Baldwin, 2025 ) . Class imbalance does not affect the asymptotic sample complexity of PAC learning. Section 3.3 shows, for one verifier family, that labels produced by an existing trigger inversion method suffice for reconstruction with overhead matching Theorem 1 ’s label-noise bound.

blocks.en:
We test the two routes (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ) with three experiments.
Experiment 1 contrasts a learnable verifier with a cryptographically asymmetric one and verifies the dichotomy predicted by Corollary 1 .
Experiment 2 verifies the predicted sample-complexity scaling on a verifier family of varying complexity.
Experiment 3 enumerates the channels through which an attacker could supply a secret key to M V M_{V} and verifies that none preserves cryptographic asymmetry.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Backdoor attacks have evolved since Gu et al. (2017) along the axis of trigger expressiveness, in NLP from single-token insertion ( Kurita et al., 2020 ; Dai et al., 2019 ) to syntactic templates ( Qi et al., 2021b ) , style transfer ( Qi et al., 2021a ) , and statistical signatures ( Yan et al., 2023 ) , and in LLMs to instruction tuning ( Wan et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024a ) , RLHF manipulation ( Rando and Tramèr, 2023 ) , and persistent backdoors that survive safety training ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2025 ) .
Apart from the embedding surgery of Kurita et al. (2020) , which edits weights directly, these works install the verifier through poisoned data, treat generalization to unseen trigger inputs as the success criterion of the attack, and use verifiers that fall within the class learnable by polynomial-size networks.
The stealth claimed by the syntactic, stylistic, and statistical attacks is evasion of particular detectors, which is a different property from computational unreconstructibility, and Appendix B finds no installation-reconstruction gap for them once comparable observations are available.
On the theoretical side, Manoj and Blum (2021) and Yu et al. (2024) bound memorization capacity and generalization for poisoning attacks within the learnable class. We show that poisoning cannot succeed beyond it.
blocks.zh:
自古等人(2017年)以来,后门攻击沿触发表达力轴线发展,NLP从单键插入(Kurita等人,2020年;Dai等人,2019年)演变为合成模板(Qi等人,2021年b),风格转移(Qi等人,2021年a),统计签名(Yan等人,2023年),LLMS到指令调试(Wan等人,2023年;Xu等人,2024年a),RLHF操纵(Rando和Tramèr,2023年),以及持续安全训练的持久后门(Hubinger等人,2024年;Kong等人,2025年).
除了直接编辑权重的Kurita等人(2020年)的嵌入外科外,这些作品通过中毒数据安装了验证器,将概括到隐形触发输入作为攻击的成功标准,并使用属于可被多名大小网络学习的类内的验证器.
综合,文体和统计攻击所声称的隐形是逃避特定探测器,这是与计算不可重建性不同的属性,附录B发现一旦有可比的观测结果,它们就没有安装-重建的缺口.
在理论方面,马诺伊和布卢姆(2021年)和于等人. (2024年)将可学班内中毒攻击的记忆能力和概括化. 我们显示,中毒是无法成功的。

blocks.en:
A wide range of empirical defenses recover trigger patterns by inverting model behavior, including Neural Cleanse ( Wang et al., 2019 ) , ABS ( Liu et al., 2019 ) , and PICCOLO ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , followed by generative inversion ( Azizi et al., 2021 ) , constrained optimization ( Shen et al., 2022 ) , and activation-space analysis ( Xu et al., 2024b ) .
Each targets a specific trigger class, and we frame all of them as learning-based reconstruction, characterized by the VC dimension of the verifier (Theorem 1 ).
Oblivious defense ( Goldwasser et al., 2025 ) removes backdoors without detecting them and is the natural response when representative trigger observations cannot be obtained. It sidesteps acquisition, while we show that once acquisition has succeeded there is no further computational barrier.
blocks.zh:
大量经验性防御通过倒置模型行为恢复触发规律,包括神经清洁(Wang等人,2019年),ABS(Liu等人,2019年),PICCOLO(Liu等人,2022年),之后是基因反转(Azizi等人,2021年),限制性优化(Shen等人,2022年),激活空间分析(Xu等人,2024年b).
每个都针对一个特定的触发课,我们把所有这些课都设定为基于学习的重建,其特点是核查器的VC维度(定理1 ).
盲目的防御(Goldwasser等人,2025年)移除后门而不发现后门,是无法取得代表性触发观测结果时的自然反应. 它回避了收购,而我们却表明一旦收购成功,就没有进一步的计算障碍.

blocks.en:
A separate line of work constructs backdoors whose hardness is cryptographic, and what separates them from Corollary 1 is the installation channel. Goldwasser et al. (2022) plant a digital-signature verifier by direct model modification, giving black-box undetectability, and plant a white-box-undetectable verifier into a random-feature model by tampering with the random coins of an otherwise faithful learner. Draguns et al. (2024) compile cryptographic primitives directly into transformer weights.
Neither is poisoning-based, so neither falls under Lemma 1 , and in both the weights are observable while the verifier they encode need not be efficiently recoverable.
Closest to our theory, Christiano et al. (2025) study a game in which the attacker directly chooses a backdoored function from a class and the defender must flag the trigger at evaluation time. They show that efficient PAC learnability implies efficient defendability and, using indistinguishability obfuscation, that polynomial-size circuits are not efficiently defendable. Their negative result lives in the direct-specification channel. Our contribution is the observation that restricting the attacker to poisoning removes that channel, so that within it the installable verifiers are exactly the efficiently learnable ones and the obfuscation barrier does not arise.
Table 3 classifies prior work by channel, access model, and claimed property. Cryptographic asymmetry is available to an attacker who controls the training randomness or the weights, and unavailable to one who controls only the data.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown that a backdoor installed through poisoned data cannot exhibit cryptographic asymmetry against a white-box defender who holds representative labeled observations of the trigger condition.
A poisoning procedure that installs a verifier is itself a learner for that verifier, so whatever poisoning can install, learning can reconstruct, and whatever learning cannot reconstruct, poisoning cannot install. A secret consulted at inference is observable to the same defender, and experiments on instruction-tuned LLMs confirm the dichotomy.
For verifier-level defense against poisoning, the only barrier is acquiring representative observations. Once they are in hand, there is no cryptographic obstacle to reconstruction.
Cryptographic backdoors exist, but they enter through the training randomness, through direct weight specification, or through an external oracle, and the reduction explains why every known construction uses one of these channels. An attacker limited to poisoning the data has no access to them.
blocks.zh:
我们已经表明,通过有毒数据安装的后门不能对持有对触发条件具有代表性的标记观察的白盒捍卫者显示密码不对称。
安装验证器的中毒程序本身就是该验证器的学习者,所以无论任何中毒可以安装,学习可以重建,无论学习不能重建,中毒不能安装. 同一辩护人可以观察到在推论中咨询过的秘密,关于指令调制LLMs的实验证实了二分法.
为了对中毒进行核查,唯一的障碍是获得代表性的观察。 一旦它们被掌握,重建就不存在密码障碍。
密码后门存在,但它们通过训练的随机性,通过直接的重量规格,或者通过外部的甲骨文进入,这种还原性解释了为什么每个已知的构造都使用其中一个通道. 一个仅限于对数据下毒的攻击者无法接触到这些数据。

blocks.en: Appendix B Verification on Prior Poisoning-Based Backdoor Methods
blocks.zh: 附录B 对先前中毒后门的核查 方法

blocks.en:
We confirm that the dichotomy of Corollary 1 holds for poisoning-based backdoor methods proposed in the literature.
Specifically, we re-evaluate three representative backdoor methods using the protocol of Section 3.1 , with the same four LLMs, Tulu V3 base corpus, trigger-count sweep, and held-out evaluation pool.
We use Hidden Killer [ Qi et al., 2021b ] as the syntactic-template attack, StyleBkd [ Qi et al., 2021a ] as the stylistic attack, and BITE [ Yan et al., 2023 ] as the statistical-signature attack. 5 5 5 These methods were originally evaluated on classification models with label-flipping objectives. Their verifier structures (constituency parse templates, target writing styles, learned trigger-word combinations) apply unchanged to the SFT generative setting, where the attacker target is the fixed response r ⋆ r^{\star} rather than a flipped label. The single-token and k k -token AND families covered in Experiments 1 and 2 are not repeated here.
For each method, we report held-out ASR (attack generalization) and held-out DSR using a defender of the same architecture as the attacker, averaged over the four-LLM diagonal and three seeds at N trig = 10 4 N_{\mathrm{trig}}=10^{4} .

Held-out ASR and held-out DSR decline together as verifier expressiveness increases, from syntactic templates to statistical signatures.
The gap between ASR and DSR remains small across all three methods, consistent with the prediction that attacker and defender face the same learning problem in the same hypothesis class.
The verifier surface forms used in these methods span syntactic templates, style transfer, and statistical signatures, yet the underlying learning difficulty does not exhibit the structural asymmetry that would block defense in principle.
Where prior trigger-inversion defenses underperform on richer verifiers, our results indicate the difficulty is shared by the attacker as well, since the attacker’s own held-out ASR drops in lockstep with the defender’s DSR.
The empirical hardness of defending against expressive verifiers is accompanied by a corresponding empirical hardness of installing them.

blocks.zh: 一、导 言 索赔问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了文件的贡献和范围? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 第1节和抽象的不可能索赔正式定为第2节的定理1和提议1,第3节按经验加以核实。 2. 限制问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制? 答复:[是] 说明:第2.4节讨论了所有四个假设的现实性,定义3明确将结果的范围扩大到自足的后门。 3. 理论假设和证明 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明? 回答:[是] 理由:假设1-4在第2.1节中阐述;在每个定理、必然结果和命题陈述之后立即提供证据。 4. 实验结果可复制 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)? 答复:[是] 说明:第3.1节具体规定了带有版本识别符、培训程序和评价协议的四个LLMs;每个实验小节(第3.2至3.4节)提供核查规格和衡量标准。 5. 开放存取数据和代码 文件是否提供了开放的数据和代码,并有足够的指示,如补充材料所述,忠实地复制主要实验结果? 答复:理由:出于双重用途考虑,没有解除密码和后门检查站。 6. 实验设置/细节问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(如数据分割、超参数、如何选择、优化者的类型)? 答复:[是] 说明:第3.1节描述了SFT的配方、清洁准确度过滤标准、触发计数扫描和搁置评价池;每个试验小节都提供了具体核查者的详细资料。 7. 实验统计意义 问题: 纸质报告错误是否含有适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 所有报告的指标都指三粒种子(第3.3节为五粒);通过麦克内马尔第3.2节的测试,评估对角攻击者-防御者对子的统计意义。 8. 实验计算资源 问题:对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息? 答复:[是] 理由:计算资源在补充材料中列报。 9. 道德守则问题:文件中进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)? 答复:[是]理由: 这项研究符合《新IPS道德守则》。 10. 更广泛的影响问题:本文件是否讨论所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 结果是防御性的贡献,加强了核查员一级防御的基础(第5节);预计不会产生任何负面的社会影响,因为这项工作确定了不可能,没有引进新的攻击能力。 11. 保障问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高度滥用风险的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或报废数据集)而实施的保障措施? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 没有发布新的预先训练过的模型或被刮掉的数据集;为实验生产的后门检查站不公开发布. 12. 现有资产的许可证 问题:纸张中是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原所有人,是否适当贷记,许可证和使用条款是否明确提及和适当遵守? 答复:[是] 说明:所有基础LLM(Quen2.5:Apache 2.0;Llama-3:Llama 3 社区许可证;Mistral:Apache 2.0;Gemma-2:Gemma 术语使用)和Tulu V3beau(ODC-BY)均在第3.1节中引用,并按各自的许可证使用,所有许可证都允许研究使用. 13. 新资产问题:文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否与资产一起提供文件? 答复:[不详]理由: 没有释放新的资产。 14. 人口集中和人类课题研究 关于众包实验和与人类主体的研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示全文和(如果适用的话)截图,以及(如果有)补偿的细节? 答复:[不详]理由: 不适用。 15. 机构审查委员会(IRB)批准或相当于与人有关的研究 文件是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险,是否向主体披露了这些风险,以及是否获得了机构审查委员会的批准(或根据贵国或机构的要求获得同等的批准/审查)? 答复:[不详]理由: 不适用。 16. 关于LLM使用的声明问题: 论文是否描述了LLMs的使用,如果它是本研究核心方法的重要、原始或非标准组成部分? 请注意,如果LLM只用于书写、编辑或格式化目的,且不影响研究的核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性,则不需要宣布。 答复:[不适用]说明:法学硕士作为分析对象,而不是作为方法的组成部分。

blocks.en: Claims
blocks.zh: 索偿

blocks.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
blocks.zh: 问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了文件的贡献和范围?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The impossibility claims in the abstract and Section 1 are formalized as Theorem 1 and Proposition 1 in Section 2 , and empirically verified in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 第1节和抽象的不可能索赔正式定为第2节的定理1和提议1,第3节按经验加以核实。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Section 2.4 discusses the realism of all four assumptions, and Definition 3 explicitly scopes the result to self-contained backdoors.
blocks.zh: 说明:第2.4节讨论了所有四个假设的现实性,定义3明确将结果的范围扩大到自足的后门。

blocks.en: Theory assumptions and proofs
blocks.zh: 理论假设和证明

blocks.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Assumptions 1 – 4 are stated in Section 2.1 ; proofs are provided immediately after each theorem, corollary, and proposition statement.
blocks.zh: 理由:假设1-4在第2.1节中陈述;在每个定理、必然结果和命题说明之后立即提供证据。

blocks.en: Experimental result reproducibility
blocks.zh: 实验结果可复制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Section 3.1 specifies the four LLMs with version identifiers, the training procedure, and the evaluation protocol; each experiment subsection (Sections 3.2 – 3.4 ) provides verifier specifications and metrics.
blocks.zh: 说明:第3.1节具体规定了带有版本识别符、培训程序和评价协议的四个LLMs;每个实验小节(第3.2至3.4节)提供核查规格和衡量标准。

blocks.en: Open access to data and code
blocks.zh: 开放对数据和代码的访问

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否提供了开放的数据和代码,并有足够的指示,如补充材料所述,忠实地复制主要实验结果?

blocks.en: Answer: [No]
blocks.zh: 答复:[无]

blocks.en: Justification: Code and backdoored checkpoints are not released due to dual-use concerns.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 由于对双重用途的关切,代码和后门检查站没有解除管制。

blocks.en: Experimental setting/details
blocks.zh: 实验设置/细节

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(如数据分割、超参数、如何选择、优化者的类型)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Section 3.1 describes the SFT recipe, clean-accuracy filtering criterion, trigger-count sweep, and held-out evaluation pool; verifier-specific details are given in each experiment subsection.
blocks.zh: 说明:第3.1节描述了SFT的配方、清洁准确度过滤标准、触发计数扫描和搁置评价池;每个试验小节都提供了具体核查者的详细资料。

blocks.en: Experiment statistical significance
blocks.zh: 实验统计意义

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸质报告错误是否含有适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: All reported metrics are means over three seeds (five in Section 3.3 ); statistical significance on diagonal attacker–defender pairs is assessed via McNemar’s test in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 所有报告的指标都指三粒种子(第3.3节为五粒);通过麦克内马尔第3.2节的测试,评估对角攻击者-防御者对子的统计意义。

blocks.en: Experiments compute resources
blocks.zh: 计算资源

blocks.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人的类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Compute resources are reported in the supplemental material.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 计算资源情况在补充材料中报告。

blocks.en: Code of ethics
blocks.zh: 道德守则

blocks.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
blocks.zh: 问题: 本文所进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新教IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The research conforms with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 这项研究符合《新IPS道德守则》。

blocks.en: Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The result is a defensive contribution that strengthens the foundation for verifier-level defense (Section 5 ); no negative societal impacts are anticipated, as the work establishes an impossibility and does not introduce novel attack capabilities.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 结果是防御性的贡献,加强了核查员一级防御的基础(第5节);预计不会产生任何负面的社会影响,因为这项工作确定了不可能,没有引进新的攻击能力。

blocks.en: Safeguards
blocks.zh: 保障措施

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高度滥用风险的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或报废数据集)而实施的保障措施?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: No new pretrained models or scraped datasets are released; backdoored checkpoints produced for the experiments are not publicly released.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 没有发布新的预先训练过的模型或被刮掉的数据集;为实验生产的后门检查站不公开发布.

blocks.en: Licenses for existing assets
blocks.zh: 现有资产的许可证

blocks.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有人,是否适当贷记,许可证和使用条款是否明确提及和适当遵守?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: All base LLMs (Qwen2.5: Apache 2.0; Llama-3: Llama 3 Community License; Mistral: Apache 2.0; Gemma-2: Gemma Terms of Use) and the Tulu V3 corpus (ODC-BY) are cited in Section 3.1 and used in accordance with their respective licenses, all of which permit research use.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 所有基础LLM(Quen2.5:Apache 2.0;Llama-3:Llama 3社区许可证;Mistral:Apache 2.0;Gemma-2:Gemma 术语使用)和Tulu V3aule(ODC-BY)均在第3.1节中引用,并按各自的许可证使用,这些许可证都允许研究使用.

blocks.en: New assets
blocks.zh: 新资产

blocks.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否与资产一起提供文件?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: No new assets are released.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 没有释放新的资产。

blocks.zh: 与人类学科的群包和研究

blocks.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.zh: 理由说明: 不适用。

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]

blocks.zh: 理由说明: 不适用。
